about_the_game:
Paint, Compete, and Win!

Welcome to Paint Rumble, the most colorful and fast-paced party game you’ve ever played! Here, strategy and quick reflexes are all you need to dominate the battlefield. In thrilling 2-minute matches, your goal is simple: paint the most area on the screen before time runs out. Sounds easy? Wait until your friends start painting over your color!

Choose Your Character and Join the Chaos!

Play as one of four charismatic competitors: 🎨 Wolfy – The blue wolf, fast and clever.
🎨 Quacky – The yellow duck, always excited!
🎨 Tigro – The green tiger, fierce and competitive.
🎨 Lucky – The purple mouse, small but quick!

Each character brings their favorite color to the arena, but only one will emerge victorious!

Game Modes

🎮 Free-for-All – Every player for themselves! Whoever paints the most, wins!

🎮 Team Battle (2v2) – Team up with a friend and take down your rivals!

How to Play?

  • Control your character with a keyboard, controller, or play against AI opponents.

  • Dodge enemies and paint as much of the area as possible before time runs out.

  • Power-ups appear during the match – grab them before your opponents and turn the game in your favor!

  • Choose how many rounds to play – best of 3, 4, or 5? It’s up to you!

Play With Anyone!

🌎 Online Multiplayer – Challenge players from around the world or create a private room for friends.
🛋️ Local Multiplayer (Couch Co-op) – Gather your friends and play on the same PC, sharing the keyboard or using controllers.

Paint Rumble is guaranteed fun for all ages! With simple yet challenging mechanics, it’s perfect for anyone looking to test their agility, strategy, and, of course, friendships!

Author’s Letter

"I was never someone who spent hours and hours playing video games. In fact, during my childhood, teenage years, and early adulthood, games were only present in occasional moments. But even so, there is one game that has stayed in my heart forever. The few times I played were simply unforgettable. I remember sitting there with my mother, father, siblings, and sometimes even school friends. All of us squeezed into a single computer chair, sharing the same keyboard. Each person using two fingers, and when there were four of us, eight fingers crammed onto one small keyboard. It was chaotic, but it was magical.

These memories carry an energy that words can barely describe. It wasn't just the game itself, but what it provided: laughter, shouts of victory, and even that fun little conflict when someone pressed the wrong button at the wrong time. Simple moments, but so full of life.

Now, years later, I have the privilege of bringing this experience to you. It’s not just a game; it’s an attempt to capture and share a small piece of the joy that defined my childhood. I hope that when you play, you feel the same connection, fun, and emotion that I did. This game is my tribute to those memories – and now, it can be part of your story too."
detailed_description:
Feature List

🔥 Special Feature – Online & Local Multiplayer! 🎨

Play Paint Rumble like never before! In addition to the classic local mode to challenge your friends on the same PC, now you can connect with the whole world with our online multiplayer mode!

✅ Create your own room and invite friends for epic battles.
✅ Join public matches and compete against players from around the globe.
✅ Fast-paced real-time action, full of strategy and power-ups!

Now, the fun has no limits – challenge, win, and paint the screen like a true champion!

short_description: Paint Rumble is a fast-paced party game where strategy and reflexes matter! Cover the most area in 2-minute battles, playing solo, in teams, or against friends locally or online. Choose Wolfy, Quacky, Tigro, or Lucky, grab power-ups, and use your agility to dominate the battlefield!
